reader.requirement: At --std 85, LAST DETAIL integer-4 must be at least FIRST DETAIL integer-3, where integer-3 may be defaulted to integer-2 (GR2b) and integer-4 to integer-5 or integer-1 (GR2c, GR2d), in any phrase order, with equality allowed.

edition-consulted.switches: ExceedsThreeSignificantDigits85 (DialectLevel < 2002) adds the 1985 SR2 digit limit; the ascending-order loop runs the same at every edition
ReportPageSubclauseContext is Nonzero at every edition; ZeroMessage cites §1985:III.2 below 2002 (wording only)
LAST CONTROL HEADING, the DE abbreviation and IS before an integer are refused below 2002 (COBOL0900)

reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1270 covers the legal side (FIRST DETAIL 4 LAST DETAIL 9); the refused side and the defaulted operands are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL2744 the FIRST DETAIL integer 10 is greater than the LAST DETAIL integer 9, exit 65 (also COBOL2199 for the detail group)
COBOL2744 FIRST DETAIL 10 > LAST DETAIL 9 with LAST DETAIL written first, exit 65
probes.expected: refused: the phrases may be in any order (SR1); the rule is about values

probes.printed: COBOL2744 the HEADING integer 10 is greater than the LAST DETAIL integer 9, exit 65 (FIRST DETAIL omitted)
probes.expected: refused: integer-3 defaults to integer-2 = 10 > integer-4 = 9

probes.printed: COBOL2744 the FIRST DETAIL integer 12 is greater than the FOOTING integer 11, exit 65 (LAST DETAIL omitted)
probes.expected: refused: integer-4 defaults to integer-5 = 11 < integer-3 = 12 (GR2d)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR5  (3.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5
OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The pairwise check of the written integers also catches violations that pass through the GR2 defaults, since each default copies a written neighbour: a defaulted integer-3 is compared by way of HEADING, and a defaulted integer-4 by way of FOOTING. Each probe was refused or accepted as the 1985 text requires. The diagnostic cites 2023.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85: pgfdlim (PAGE 30 FIRST DETAIL 40, with LAST DETAIL and FOOTING omitted so integer-4 = integer-1 = 30 by GR2c) gives COBOL2744 'the FIRST DETAIL integer 40 is greater than the page limit 30', exit 65. pgldneg (LAST DETAIL -1) gives COBOL0001, exit 65. pgrevok (FIRST DETAIL 2 LAST DETAIL 20, written out of order) exit 0, OK. With the reader's pgldlt, pgorder, pglddef and pgfdgt4, every defaulted pairing GR2 b to e can produce is covered. OK §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR5 'Integer-4 must be greater than or equal to integer-3'; OK §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2.
